forecast_origin: end of day t; predictors only through day t
split_note: Organizer-proposed public catchment split; not an official challenge leaderboard.

evaluation_protocol.stress_test_c: local reproducible input corruption checks only
evaluation_protocol.note: Validation catchments are absent from model training, but this is not the organizer's hidden Test B or a chronological Test A.

horizon_status: Exploratory only. The attached challenge documentation calls 1, 3, and 7 days provisional and says the official horizon set is not frozen.
date_axis_validation: Every selected catchment was required to have a strictly increasing, consecutive daily date coordinate before row-offset forecasting.
static_attribute_note: Uses Caravan climate attributes, selected HydroATLAS climate/terrain/soil fields, area, and coordinates. HydroATLAS discharge and runoff summaries are excluded to avoid target leakage.
training_target_transform: asinh(streamflow(t+h)) - asinh(streamflow(t)); inverse transform at inference
training_row_weighting: Each catchment has equal total regression weight within each horizon; for 3-day regression, training-only high-flow rows receive a fixed 2x multiplier, renormalized so each catchment keeps equal total weight. Event classifiers retain unboosted equal-catchment weights.
experiment_note: Use --horizons 3 --run-name h3-event-weighted to fit only the 3-day event-weighted experiment and write separate artifacts.
row_sampling: Deterministic uniform sample from valid, nonnegative streamflow forecast origins; validity is applied before per-catchment caps.
metric_notes: Pooled NSE/KGE use all scored rows and one global target mean.
Basin-centered NSE sums within-catchment errors and variance, avoiding between-basin mean differences in its denominator.
Median per-catchment NSE/KGE use basins with at least 30 scored rows; all-basin medians and excluded counts are reported too.
Very negative per-catchment NSE values can occur when observed flow variance is near zero; they are retained in per-catchment outputs rather than clipped.

extreme_event_config.threshold_estimation: Median per-training-catchment quantile from complete valid training forecast origins, aggregated by source before row caps.

scenarios: 10 percent of dynamic inputs set missing
10 percent feature-standard-deviation Gaussian noise on dynamic inputs
latest day flow, precipitation and meteorology unavailable

validation_protocol: Catchments are held out by the provided manifest; no validation-based early stopping or threshold tuning is performed. Climatology and event thresholds are fit using training catchments only.

model.prediction: catchment-weighted asinh residual CatBoost with static attributes

uncertainty_and_intervals.predictive_distribution: Gaussian CatBoost RMSEWithUncertainty on asinh flow residuals; transformed back to nonnegative mm/day flow
uncertainty_and_intervals.crps_method: Empirical ensemble CRPS with 32 deterministic-seed Monte Carlo draws per validation row

extreme_flow_and_probabilities.definition: Separate extreme-high-flow event: target exceeds the median per-training-catchment 99th percentile; thresholds use training data only.
extreme_flow_and_probabilities.threshold_estimation: Median of per-training-catchment quantiles computed from all valid training forecast origins before row sampling/capping.

events_and_probabilities.definition: Source-specific high-flow event: target exceeds the median per-training-catchment 90th percentile; thresholds use training data only.
events_and_probabilities.threshold_estimation: Median of per-training-catchment quantiles computed from all valid training forecast origins before row sampling/capping.
